note: Printable flyers listed on flyers.html. Each flyer's print source is flyers/src/<id>.html; run `node scripts/build_flyers.cjs` to rebuild the PDFs and preview images after editing a source.

flyers.title: Veteran Resource Guide flyer
flyers.use: For a bulletin board or front desk: VA clinics, county veterans offices, senior centers, nursing homes, libraries, churches and veteran posts.
flyers.alt: Yellow flyer headed "Find veteran help near you" with a QR code to guide.vethomeguard.org, crisis numbers and ten kinds of help in the guide.

flyers.title: Family Guide flyer
flyers.use: For a bulletin board: pediatric and therapy waiting rooms, schools, libraries, churches and community centers.
flyers.alt: Flyer headed "Worried about your child?" with two age choices, Ohio phone numbers, a QR code to the Family Guide and the 988 crisis line.

flyers.title: Family Guide handout
flyers.use: To hand to a parent or leave at a front desk. The two-per-page version prints on regular letter paper; cut it in half.
flyers.alt: Half-sheet handout headed "Worried about your child?" with two age choices, Ohio phone numbers, a QR code to the Family Guide and the 988 crisis line.
